factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 43 shows capital investments decreased 14.4% to EUR 33,245k. Management report details major investments in Paldiski South Harbour quay, Muuga quay reinforcement, and ferry maintenance.

factual_claims.claim: Net debt declined 15.5% to EUR 141.7 million, and operating cash flow increased to EUR 53.7 million from EUR 48.7 million.
